description: Defines the abstract class AccessResult for handling access permission results with cacheability metadata in Drupal. Includes static methods for creating allowed, forbidden, neutral results, and methods for combining results with logical AND/OR operations.

classes.name: AccessResult
classes.description: Abstract class representing an access permission result with cacheability metadata, providing static factory methods and logical combination methods.

methods.name: neutral
methods.description: Creates an access result with neutral permission status, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: allowed
methods.description: Creates an access result indicating permission is allowed.

methods.name: forbidden
methods.description: Creates an access result indicating permission is forbidden, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: allowedIf
methods.description: Creates an allowed or neutral access result based on a condition.

methods.name: forbiddenIf
methods.description: Creates a forbidden or neutral access result based on a condition.

methods.name: allowedIfHasPermission
methods.description: Creates an allowed or neutral result based on whether an account has a specific permission.

methods.name: allowedIfHasPermissions
methods.description: Creates an allowed or neutral result based on multiple permissions with conjunction logic.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the result indicates permission is allowed.

methods.name: isForbidden
methods.description: Checks if the result indicates permission is forbidden.

methods.name: isNeutral
methods.description: Checks if the result indicates a neutral permission state.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts associated with the result.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with the result.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the maximum cache age for the result.

methods.name: resetCacheContexts
methods.description: Resets cache contexts to empty.

methods.name: resetCacheTags
methods.description: Resets cache tags to empty.

methods.name: setCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Sets the maximum cache age.

methods.name: cachePerPermissions
methods.description: Adds 'user.permissions' to cache contexts.

methods.name: cachePerUser
methods.description: Adds 'user' to cache contexts.

methods.name: orIf
methods.description: Combines this access result with another using logical OR, merging cacheability metadata.

methods.name: andIf
methods.description: Combines this access result with another using logical AND, merging cacheability metadata.

methods.name: inheritCacheability
methods.description: Inherits cacheability metadata from another access result, merging max-age appropriately.
